definitions.explanation: Food that accompanies the main staple (typically rice in Japanese cuisine). Includes dishes like fish, meat, vegetables, and soup that are eaten alongside the staple grain.

examples.japanese: {副食|ふくしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副食|ふくしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: The side dishes in school lunches are designed with nutritional balance in mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧、⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧や⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{副食|ふくしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: In contrast to rice as the staple food, fish and vegetable dishes are called side dishes.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (secondary, supplementary) + {食|しょく} (food). Contrasted with ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧ (staple food, usually rice). More formal than the everyday word ⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{副食|ふくしょく} (staple food and side dishes)
- {副食|ふくしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品数|しなかず}→品数：18814_shinakazu⟧ (number of side dishes)
- {副食費|ふくしょくひ} (side dish expenses, meal supplement costs)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧: side dish — the everyday, casual term
- ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧: staple food — the main carbohydrate, usually rice, bread, or noodles
